images.caption: The Center Building at St. Elizabeths Hospital in Washington, D.C.  Like most buildings at St. Elizabeths, this one has been abandoned.  The Center Building is one of the oldest buildings on the campus, dating to the American Civil War era.

images.caption: St. Elizabeth's Hospital. Wall of room in Ward Retreat 1. Reproductions made by a patient, a disturbed case of dementia praecox; pin or fingernail used to scratch paint from wall, top coat of paint buff color, superimposed upon a brick red coat of paint. Pictures symbolize events in patient's past life and represent a mild state of mental regression. Undated, but likely early 20th century. Selected by Kathleen.
